questions.text: Please introduce yourself and summarize the kinds of systems you have worked on.
What is the difference between a stack and a queue, and when would you use each?
Explain Big-O notation and give an example of improving an algorithm's complexity.
How do you approach writing unit tests versus integration tests?
Describe a design pattern you have used and why it was appropriate.
How would you design a simple URL shortener at a high level?
How would you design a notification system that supports email, SMS, and push?
Walk me through how you debug a difficult intermittent bug.
Tell me about a time you had to learn a new technology quickly under deadline pressure.
How do you give constructive code review feedback?
How do you balance shipping features quickly with maintaining code quality?
What is version control, and why is branching strategy important on a team?
